nodes.label: Asian Fusion Crispy Glazed Chicken or Cauliflower in Cast Iron Skillet
nodes.description: Crispy fried chicken or cauliflower pieces coated in a sticky, caramelized Asian-style sauce served in a cast iron skillet. Garnished with sliced scallions, sesame seeds, fresh microgreens, and chili pieces. Presentation is modern American restaurant with Asian fusion influence — rustic yet elevated. Shot on a warm wood-grain surface for an appetizing, social-media-ready aesthetic. Conveys bold umami-rich comfort food.
nodes.presentation: cast iron skillet, garnished with scallions, sesame seeds, microgreens, chili
